'''Flash Company''' was one of two companies that made up [[ThunderForce]]. It had approximately 400 beings in it and was divided into eight [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]]. Two of the platoons were housed at the headquarters of Thunderforce.<ref name="H&S" />
